description: Sri Lanka Anti-Doping Agency - Anti Doping (Prohibited List) Regulations No. 07 of 2021
reasoning: This gazette content contains regulations made by the Minister of Sports under the Convention against Doping in Sports Act, No. 33 of 2013. It specifically publishes the "Anti-Doping (Prohibited List) Regulations No.07 of 2021" and includes the detailed 2022 Prohibited List of substances and methods banned in sports. This falls under Legal/Regulatory classification as it involves regulatory frameworks, compliance requirements, and statutory instruments related to anti-doping in sports.
